title: Mathematical notes
text:
Notes, proofs, and worked exercises. Choose a subject to open its book.


Linear algebra
Vector spaces, additive inverses, and first principles. Proofs paired with Lean code from the original notes.


Convex optimization
Convex sets, convex combinations, hyperplanes, and halfspaces. Definitions alongside worked exercises.


Analysis
Set identities and the Weierstrass function: continuity and nowhere differentiability.


Foundations
Relations, their basic properties, and exercises with ordered pairs.



Adapted from my LaTeX notes. Each book has its own contents, search, and mathematical references. Where provided, Lean snippets link to the original online playground.
